title: Durable Fair Active-Health Checkpoint (generation-CAS)

implementation.newTable: active_health_checkpoints(scope_key TEXT PK, cursor TEXT NULL, generation BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, updated_at BIGINT NOT NULL)
implementation.casSemantics: expectedGeneration < 0 = INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; else UPDATE WHERE scope_key=? AND generation=?; generation+1 on success

verifiedBehaviors: wrap CAS to NULL durable across restart
stale write after newer cursor rejected
concurrent same-generation writers: exactly one wins
supervisor identity isolation via scope key
absent row distinguished from existing NULL-cursor row
in-memory cursor does not advance on CAS failure
limitations: Coordination state only; never authoritative deployment/release/recovery state.
AWS_REGION_NOT_CONFIGURED remains BLOCKED for real-AWS paths.
